# 19:00–20:00 • The Pelé Pact • layered asset pack

**Status:** Assets/cutouts and unanimated scene previews only. No repository files were changed and no animation was implemented.

## Import

Unzip into your studio asset library. Use the paths in `09_manifest/scene_layer_order_and_timing.json` to place each layer. The four generated PNG masters and all other procedurally generated layers remain independent. Use the supplied 1920×1080 background plates.

## Contents

- `01_backgrounds`: negotiation room, blank rival-brand backdrop, Mexico 1970 wood, newspaper tabletop, cinematic interstitial.
- `02_figures`: independent handshake, two illustrative corporate-executive portraits, seated silhouettes, audience occlusion.
- `03_sponsorship_money`: fictional period-inspired notes, independently replaceable fanned bill groups and lighting overlay.
- `04_mexico_1970`: editable SVG tournament mark, blank yellow poster layer and convenience pre-composite.
- `05_historical_editorial`: illustrated photo inserts, five independent newspapers, three photo print cutouts, **editable newspaper copy JSON**.
- `06_brand_cards`: editable SVG approximation logos, transparent mark PNGs, blank weathered cards, convenience composites, independent vector red-X strokes.
- `07_motion_overlays`: separate cyan/red/amber smoky overlays, embers, light rays, film grain, vignette.
- `08_preview`: nine fixed-frame storyboard composites for inspection. These are not source layers.
- `09_manifest`: assets inventory (SHA-256, transparency), source and rights notes, scene timing and layer order.

## Historical integrity and creative decisions

Narration provided by the user states a sponsorship race, rising cost and a secret agreement not to sign Pelé before the 1970 World Cup. The scenery, executive likenesses, money and fictional newspaper facsimiles are **cinematic illustrations, not authentic documents or verified photographs**. Do not represent generated portraits as definitive archival photos of Horst Dassler or Armin Dassler. Do not reuse reconstructed headlines as historical proof. Wikimedia Commons links for authentic 1970 Pelé photographs are included as pointers in the sources manifest, but those photographs are **not included in this ZIP** because the direct image downloads were unavailable in this environment.

The Adidas/Puma SVG marks are edit-friendly illustrative approximations; use approved original brand vector artwork if perfect brand fidelity is required. The money is clearly labeled *NON-CURRENCY / FILM PROP*. The tournament mark is a drawn concept rather than an official licensed emblem.

## Layer priorities

**Do not flatten** a subject into its backdrop. Handshake above seated characters; portraits above the brand stage, money above portraits; Mexico badge above wood; newspapers individually above the newspaper table, photos and logo cards above newspapers, red X marks above logo cards. Never bake real editable text into the background unless using the convenience PNGs as mockups.

## Quality and fidelity

Most graphics are larger than the 640×360 reference source; full-scene backgrounds are 1920×1080. Generated figure/photo crops vary in resolution and are marked as such. New illustrations aim for cinematic visual cohesion rather than literal pixel match; final compositing must still be aligned to the user's reference frame calibration.

**No animation has yet been generated.**
